rules.title: Installation may have run out of space
rules.summary: The input contains an explicit insufficient-space message during installation.
rules.reason: Matched an explicit insufficient-space phrase. The message indicates a storage-space issue but does not establish the exact cause.
possible_causes: Available space was below the installer's requirement.
Temporary install data may have reduced available space.
recommended_checks: Check available storage in the console settings.
Retry only after confirming enough free space for the install.
missing_information: Available free space at the time of failure.
The package size and installer's required temporary space.
Whether temporary data from a previous attempt remained.
